Employee Covenants

Confidentiality and Proprietary Information Agreement

In consideration of employment as an employee with QUALITY HEALTHCARE ACCESS PRIVATE LIMITED (the “Company”), the undersigned (the “Participant”) agrees and covenants as follows:

1. Employment with the Company as an employee (the “Engagement”), will give the Participant access to proprietary and confidential information belonging to the Company, its customers, its suppliers and others (the proprietary and confidential information is collectively referred to in this Agreement as “Confidential Information”). Confidential Information includes but is not limited to customer lists, marketing plans, proposals, contracts, technical and/or financial information, databases, software and know-how. All Confidential Information remains the confidential and proprietary information of the Company.

2. The Participant may in the course of the Engagement conceive, develop or contribute to material or information related to the Business of the Company, including, without limitation, software, technical documentation, ideas, inventions (whether or not patentable), hardware, know-how, marketing plans, designs, techniques, documentation and records, regardless of the form or media, if any, on which such is stored (referred to in this Agreement as “Proprietary Property”). The Company shall exclusively own all Proprietary Property which the Participant conceives, develops or contributes to in the course of the Engagement and all intellectual and industrial property and other rights of any kind in or relating to the Proprietary Property, including but not limited to all copyright, patent, trade secret and trade-mark rights in or relating to the Proprietary Property. For greater certainty, the Participant hereby assigns to the Company any and all rights that the Participant may have or obtain in or to the Proprietary Property. Material or information conceived, developed or contributed to by the Participant outside work hours on the Company’s premises or through the use of the Company’s property and/or

Schedule D

Time-Off Days:

  • The Employee may take up to 20 days of “Time-Off” per year (1.25 days per month will be entitled against the Earned Off and five days of Personal Off per year)
    In case of medical emergency, a maximum 7 days off can be availed per year
  • Unused Time-Off days lapsing at year-end; no encashment
  • Employee must apply for planned off at least one week in advance

Maternity/Paternity: Where local law mandates any leave, Employee and Company will cooperate to align with statutory requirements; Company shall not otherwise grant additional paid leave.

Reimbursement of Medical Expenses

The Company may reimburse the Employee for medical-related expenses up to a maximum of INR 45,000 annually. This includes reimbursement of health insurance premiums and medical expenses (such as OPD consultations, treatments, and medicines) incurred by the Employee or immediate family members, subject to submission of valid prescriptions and receipts.

Claims for reimbursement can be submitted after completion of three months of continuous engagement.

The Employee must complete a minimum of six months of engagement to be eligible for the benefit.

If the engagement terminates before six months, the Company reserves the right to recover any reimbursed amounts from the Employee’s final payment.

The reimbursement will be on a prorata basis starting from the Employee's joining date within the calendar year i.e. January-December.

Reimbursement has to be claimed strictly during the respective calendar year and no reimbursement will be eligible for the previous period.

Only medical expenses and insurance premiums incurred after the start of the Employee’s engagement shall be eligible for reimbursement.

Entitlement for Mobile Phone and Internet

The Company may reimburse the Employee for telephone and internet expenses up to a maximum of INR 4000 per month, payable on an actual expense basis. Any claims exceeding the prescribed limit must receive prior approval from the CEO or Line Manager. Claims without such approval will not be reimbursed.

The organization has intentionally set this limit on the higher side to allow flexibility in claims when required. However, it is important to maintain the intent of this policy, restricting claims strictly to mobile and Internet charges. Claims for the following will not be considered:

  1. Charges for OTT platforms
  2. Add-on services for family members
  3. Bills not in the name of the Employee

Reimbursement claims shall only be eligible for expenses incurred during the period of the Employee’s active engagement with the Company.

The Employee must submit invoices or bills in their name supporting the expenses incurred.

All on boarding documents, including detailed Company policies relevant to the engagement, will be shared with the Employee after the joining date.

Note: All policies are subject to change / amendment at the discretion of management.
